2610.11651.title: Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture for Expertise-Adaptive Qualitative Interviews Using Local LLMs
2610.11651.paper_summary: Automated interviewers and conversational agents are increasingly used in research, recruitment, customer service, and education. However, many existing systems rely on fixed question sequences and provide limited context-based personalization without considering participants' knowledge, which can lead to repetitive or irrelevant follow-up questions. Therefore, there is a need for an adaptive interviewing system that can adjust question depth while maintaining conversational continuity and semantic progression. To address this, an Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture is presented using a locally hosted Large Language Model (LLM), with the interview continuously adapted throughout the entire conversation based on the participant's responses and evolving context. The interviewer profiles participants' expertise in real time to generate knowledge-appropriate questions, well-articulated responses, and smooth transition messages that support conversational continuity. A five-module prompt-driven architecture and persistent interview-state record support these functions. The interviewer was evaluated with 246 participants. Expertise Profiling module (M3) showed 78.9% exact agreement with independently reported participant expertise, with a weighted Cohen's K of 0.80. Generate Iterative Questions module (M4) showed a strong expertise-complexity association (p=.79, p<.001), and participants reported high relevance (mean 4.41), engagement (mean 4.32), and satisfaction (mean 4.38), providing evidence that the architecture's adaptive components operated consistently with their intended functions while participants reported a positive interview experience.
2610.11651.paper_summary_zh: 自動化面試官和對話代理在研究、招聘、客戶服務和教育中越來越多地被使用。<lb/>然而，許多現有系統依賴於固定的問題序列，並且提供有限的基於上下文的個性化，未考慮參與者的知識，這可能導致重複或不相關的後續問題。<lb/>因此，需要一個自適應面試系統，能夠在保持對話連貫性和語義進展的同時調整問題的深度。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，提出了一種可證據追蹤的動態面試官架構，使用本地托管的大型語言模型（LLM），在整個對話過程中根據參與者的反應和不斷變化的上下文持續調整面試。<lb/>面試官實時分析參與者的專業知識，以生成符合知識的問題、表達清晰的回答和支持對話連貫性的平滑過渡信息。<lb/>一個五模塊的提示驅動架構和持久的面試狀態記錄支持這些功能。<lb/>面試官在246名參與者中進行了評估。<lb/>專業知識分析模塊（M3）與獨立報告的參與者專業知識顯示出78.9%的完全一致，權重Cohen's K為0.80。<lb/>生成迭代問題模塊（M4）顯示出強烈的專業知識-複雜性關聯（p=.79，p<.001），參與者報告了高相關性（平均4.41）、參與度（平均4.32）和滿意度（平均4.38），提供了證據表明該架構的自適應組件一致地運作於其預期功能，同時參與者報告了積極的面試體驗。
